title: Global Markets OHLCV — Daily & Weekly
subtitle: Cumulative 1d/1wk OHLCV CSVs from Yahoo Finance (~12k tickers)
description:
## Overview

Historical **daily and weekly OHLCV** for ~12k tickers, pulled from [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/) via [`yfinance`](https://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance).

**Intraday** bars live in a sibling dataset: [benjaminpo/finance-dataset-intraday](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/benjaminpo/finance-dataset-intraday).

Updated daily by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/benjaminpo/finance-dataset).

Source repository: [benjaminpo/finance-dataset](https://github.com/benjaminpo/finance-dataset)

## Asset classes

| Path | Coverage |
|------|----------|
| `stocks_us/` | NASDAQ listings ∪ S&P 500 |
| `stocks_kr/` | KOSPI + KOSDAQ (`.KS` / `.KQ`) |
| `stocks_jp/` | Tokyo Stock Exchange (`.T`) |
| `stocks_eu/` | STOXX / DAX / CAC / FTSE / AEX / IBEX / … |
| `stocks_hk/` | Hang Seng Index (`.HK`) |
| `stocks_tw/` | TWSE listed (`.TW`) |
| `indices/` | Major global equity indices |
| `rates/` | US Treasury yield proxies (`^IRX` … `^TYX`) |
| `futures/` | e.g. `CL=F`, `ES=F` |
| `crypto/` | BTC, ETH, SOL, … |
| `currencies/` | Major FX pairs |

## Layout & intervals

```
data/
├── stocks_us/
│   ├── 1d/AAPL.csv    # cumulative daily
│   └── 1wk/AAPL.csv   # cumulative weekly
└── …
```

- **Cumulative** (`1d`, `1wk`, and optionally `5d` / `1mo` / `3mo`): one file per ticker; new bars append, duplicate timestamps keep the last write.

## Schema

- Index: `Datetime` (UTC, ISO-8601)
- Columns: `Open`, `High`, `Low`, `Close`, `Adj Close`, `Volume` (plus `Dividends` / `Stock Splits` when present)
